dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Seahawks (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of 49ers
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: OT Charles Cross (ankle), DT Leonard Williams (stinger), and TE Nick Kallerup (ankle) logged limited practice reps Wednesday [Terrance Robinson](https://www.fieldgulls.com/seattle-seahawks-news/180797/seahawks-news-eat-well-be-thankful-beat-the-niners). OT Abraham Lucas (ankle), G Quenton Nelson (knee), DT Jarran Reed (toe), and LB DeMarcus Lawrence (shoulder) did not practice Wednesday, while QB Sam Darnold (quadricep) and LB Patrick O'Connell (toe) practiced in full [seahawks.com Official](https://www.seahawks.com/news/week-12-injury-report-seahawks-at-49ers).

Week 12 49ers Outlook: Mike Macdonald and DC Aden Durde open installation for the San Francisco 49ers (9-1, SF -3, HC Kyle Shanahan, OC Klay Kubiak & DC Raheem Morris (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Points / Game (31.6) as Seattle prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Michael Hapanovich](https://www.fieldgulls.com/seattle-seahawks-news/180756/seahawks-49ers-wednesday-injury-report-sam-darnold-practices-in-full) [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873091).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (3rd in NFC West • #8 Seed in NFC), Seattle carries a 47.1% postseason projection, 5.3% NFC West division title mark, and 1.1% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/seahawks-expecting-sam-darnold-week-12-return).

Around the Beat: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald and his father, Hugh, reflect on the journey Hugh went through last year, culminating in him getting a new kidney last fall [seahawks.com Official](https://www.seahawks.com/news/following-last-fall-s-kidney-donation-seahawks-super-bowl-lx-run-was-extra-special-for-hugh-mike-macdonald).
